A [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] '''crab''' [[Species/Legends|species]] existed on a [[Unidentified planet (creature world)|planet]] filled with [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. During the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which began during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After several escapes from the planet's other dangerous wildlife, they encountered one of the [[Crab/Legends|crabs]], which tried to intimidate them with its claws. Kenobi stepped on the crab and [[Death/Legends|killed]] it.

==Biology and appearance==
One specimen of the species was less than a single [[Meter/Legends|meter]], and was a deep orange in [[Color/Legends|color]]. It possessed twelve [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], four of which were on stalks, and two large limbs that ended in large claws. These claws were accompanied by eight smaller claws, six that were used as legs and two more for grasping things. The eyes were all black, though some had green highlights and pupils. The eight eyes on the creature's body were set apart symmetrically, with two large eyes and two small eyes on either side of its face. Underneath its shell it had a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]-like crevice filled with numerous sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and its entire body was covered in small spikes.<ref name="CC" />

The crab generally lived in or near bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]], such as lakes. The planet that the crabs existed on had lakes that were surrounded by muddy shoals and beaches. The beaches were populated with brown and green [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]].<ref name="CC" />

==History==
During the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] war known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which began during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and was set between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEW">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Unidentified planet (creature world)|swampy planet]] that the crabs existed on became a host to a Separatist base. Two Republic [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], were sent to scout out the terrain of the world and uncover the enemy establishment. After numerous encounters with the planet's dangerous wildlife, the Jedi encountered one of the crabs after crawling out of a [[lake]]. The specimen was rather small when compared to Kenobi's foot, as after the crab attempted to intimidate them with its claws, Kenobi stepped on the crab, crushing it without much effort.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The crabs first appeared in the short story ''[[Creature Comfort]]'', one of four stories compiled into the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7|seventh volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series, released on [[January 10]], [[2007]]. ''Creature Comfort'' was written and illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]]. The comic was colored by [[Ronda Pattison]].<ref name="CC" />
